svg.text: Berlin, one summer week. The air swings 10–15 °C between day and night; the top 7 cm of soil follows with less swing and an hour late, at 7–28 cm the swing is a few tenths and
peaks in the evening, and below 28 cm the daily cycle is gone: only the slow seasonal level is left. The ground is a low-pass filter: fast changes are damped first.
